balls.text: Jadeja finishes the innings with a boundary, and RR have made their way to 210! Juicy full toss just outside off. Jadeja gets his front foot out of the way and smears it into the deep square leg fence. Some momentum to take into the next innings!
another yorker on off. Archer has a pop at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards deep backward square leg. Jadeja back on strike
excellent yorker on off. Archer gets his bat down in time but cannot do much with it. Plays it back to the bowler

banged in much shorter outside off, and Jurel nicks it through! Looks for the same stroke, trying to upper-cut it over the bowler. This, though, has just enough kick on it to make the shot untenable. A bit of a variation too and that lack of pace means Jurel only finds Buttler with his effort. A brilliant knock but someone else will need to take RR close to 210 now!
short and wide outside off. Jurel jumps up onto his toes and wafts at it, only to connect with fresh air
done with surgical precision! Very full on off but this is not quite a yorker. Jurel lets his wrists power through and muscles it between long on and deep mid wicket!
slanted into the stumps. Jadeja has a massive swing at it and seems to chunk it off the inside edge into his back leg
into the blockhole outside off. Jurel squeezes it out towards extra cover
up, up and away! Length ball on leg and that is just what Jurel wants. He plants his front foot and clubs it just over deep mid wicket. Plenty of height and enough distance, as it turns out!
low full toss, spearing into leg. Jadeja backs away and tugs it towards deep square leg
full toss zoning into off. Jurel tries to hit it too hard and drags it towards deep mid wicket
very full on middle and leg. Jurel rolls his wrists and eases it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg. Back for another brace
back of a length outside off and this skips through. Jadeja has a waft at it and sees the ball whistle past his flailing blade
slower ball but the line goes awry again. Down leg and some more exercise for the umpire
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Jurel dabs it to short third and stays content with the run
hard length, honing into off. Hits the bat hard but Jurel still manages to bunt it to deep mid wicket for a brace
slower ball hung up full outside off. Too wide, though, and called as such once Jurel lets it go
short and wide outside off. Jadeja reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Jurel backs away and jabs it towards deep point
fetch that too, says Jurel! Angled in on a length on off. Jurel picks it up very early and wallops it over deep mid wicket!
fullish just outside off. Jadeja looks to go inside-out but only connects with the fresh Ahmedabad air
darted in full on the pads. Jurel works it towards deep mid wicket and has to settle for a single
a 30-ball fifty for Jurel! Angled in full on middle and leg. Jurel shuffles across and flicks it through mid wicket. Sharp work by Sudharsan on the fence to keep it to two
banged in much shorter outside off. Jurel looks to upper-cut it but fails to lay bat on ball

another miscue, but this has just enough sauce on it! Speared in full on middle and leg. Jurel's bat face opens upon contact, and the ball goes a mile up. Siraj takes it at long on and then realizes he will step over. He tries to parry it but that parry does not allow him to get back into the field of play and effect the catch. Loose palm in the end, and Jurel gets six!
on a length outside off. Jadeja has a tentative stab at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards deep square leg

skewed up, and Rabada gets his fellow South African! Dug in short outside off and this seems to get a tad big on the batter. Ferreira swipes at it because, well, why not, but gets it all wrong. Simple enough catch for Phillips at deep mid wicket, and RR are now five down!
searing yorker on middle and off. Jurel jams it off the inside edge into his pads. That was bowled at almost 154kph. Another brilliant over by Ashok!
very full again, zoning into the stumps. Ferreira scuffs it towards mid off, where Siraj fumbles, allowing the new batter to open his account
into the blockhole on middle and off. Ferreira jams down on it and clinks it out towards the bowler

flat and straight to Siraj at long on! Ashok with another timely wicket! Full outside off and Hetmyer's eyes light up. He clears his front leg and swings hard at it. Gets a good chunk of it but not enough elevation. Siraj shimmies to his left and gobbles up the chance smartly to his left. GT keep chipping away!
shot! Back of a length just outside off. Hetmyer plants his front foot and with a wave of the willow, pings it over mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Jurel uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
short and wide outside off. Jurel reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point
tossed up a touch on a fullish length on middle and off. Hetmyer prods it enough to the bowler's right and hares across to the other end
back of a length outside off. Skids through and Jurel jams it into the pitch, with the ball bouncing up over Rashid
length ball, spinning into the pads. Hetmyer tucks it towards deep backward square leg
shortish on middle and leg. Jurel goes back and works it towards deep backward square leg
Jurel clicking into over-drive now! Given a hint of air on off, and Jurel is down the track in a trice. Picks the googly too and slugs it over wide long on!
darted in on a length but also down leg. Jurel does not get bat on it and the umpire stretches out his arms
this is incredible hitting! Back of a length, sliding into middle and leg. Hetmyer jumps inside the line, picks it up and deposits it over deep backward square leg!
into the stands! Banged in short on middle and leg, and Hetmyer picks this up really early. He swivels and helps it over long leg!
low full toss outside off. Hetmyer prods it out towards extra cover

appeal for a caught-behind, but the umpire responds with a wide call! Sharp short ball that tails down leg. Hetmyer is late on the pull and seems to miss it. Keeper, bowler and Phillips think this has grazed the glove on the way but not enough conviction to take it upstairs. It does look very close, though, and UltraEdge confirms there was a murmur off the glove!
fullish just outside off. Hetmyer comes forward and defends

catching practice this time, and RR losing their way a little now! Seems like a change-up, on a length outside off. Parag does not quite pick it, and the ball stops in the surface too, further compounding the RR skipper's woes. Plonks it towards backward point, where Kushagra does just enough to cling on. Parag disappointed; GT have a foothold!
safe again! Full on middle and off. Jurel plants his front foot and then just chips it without much conviction. Falls short of long on, thankfully for him
banged into the track on middle and leg. Parag gets up on his toes and fends it into the on side
back of a length outside off. Parag uses the pace and dabs it past backward point for a couple of runs
oh, hello! Has Parag been batting in the nets all along?! Length ball sliding into the pads. Parag snaps his wrists into action and whips it over deep square leg!

off stump thumped, and Rabada has the last laugh! On a length and zoning into off stump. Jaiswal backs away, with designs to go inside-out. Comfortably late on the stroke, though, and the ball whistles past the bat before leaving off stump in a mess. Another tone-setting knock by Jaiswal comes to an end!
brilliant batting! Back of a length delivery wide outside off. Jaiswal telegraphs the line, moves across and laps it past the keeper!
safe, just! Hard length just outside off. Jaiswal has a half-hearted stab at it and nearly pops it to mid off. On the bounce eventually
Jurel goes big now! Siraj struggling with his lines and lengths. This is a full toss on the pads and Jurel shovels it over deep square leg!
not entirely in control, but Jurel will take it! Slower bumper outside off. Jurel has a swipe at it and the ball loops off the top edge over the keeper!
very full on middle and leg. Jurel shuffles across before flicking it straight to mid wicket

well well! Zipped in full on middle and off. Jaiswal moves across his stumps. trying to scoop but ends up chalking it off the bottom of the bat into the off side. Jaiswal, for his troubles, falls to the deck and has to then scurry to complete the single
class stamped all over that, and Jaiswal brings up a half-century! Back of a length outside off. Jaiswal rises with the bounce and threads it between extra cover and mid off!
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal looks for the cut but is beaten for pace as the ball skids through after pitching
streaky but Jurel will not mind it one bit! Back of a length outside off. Kicks up a little off the surface and Jurel, wafting at it, gets a thick outside edge that flies past the keeper!
shortish just outside off. Jurel goes back and stabs it to mid wicket
length ball hung up wide outside off. Jurel tries the reverse this time but only swishes at thin air

Buttler and Rashid go up for a caught-behind, but umpire Rohan Pandit says no. GT, after some deliberation, review! Darted in full and down leg. Jurel looks for the sweep and seems to play all over it. And replays confirm that suspicion. Clear gap between the bat/gloves and the ball, and GT burn a review!
googly on a length on off. Jurel reads it off the pitch and turns it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg. Back for a brace
top placement! A touch short on the stumps and Jurel makes the most ot it. He gets his front hip out of the way and punches it crisply past deep mid wicket!
banged in short and tucking up the batter on leg. Jaiswal plays all over it and gets pinged on the body
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Jurel hacks it towards deep square leg
slanted in full on the pads. Jurel flicks it straight to mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Jurel gets up on his toes and defends
smashed! On a length wide outside off. Bowled at 145.7kph but that probably went off the bat quicker. Jurel throws his hands at it and belts it over extra cover!
fullish outside off. Jurel gets onto the front foot and stabs it to mid off
shortish on middle and leg. Jaiswal rocks back and whips it between deep mid wicket and long on. Good work by Ashok to his left to keep it to two
length on middle and off. Jurel happy to stay back and work it to deep mid wicket
given a bit more air, on a length outside off. Pushed down the ground to long off
on the shorter side on middle and leg. Jurel goes back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
oh dear - bonus runs! Speared in on a length but down leg. Jurel misses his sweep and that blinds the keeper too, who cannot come around in time!
length on off. Jaiswal opens up his stance a little and punches it down to long on
slider on a back of a length on middle. Jurel hops back and hurriedly hacks it into the on side
shot! Angled in full on leg, designed to deny room. Jaiswal, though, still manufactures some. He backs away and knifes it to backward point's left!
back of a length outside off. Jurel uses the pace and runs it down to deep third
dug in short on off. Jurel hops up onto his toes before turning it towards mid wicket
excellent yorker on off. Jaiswal gets his bat down just in time and chunks it off the inside edge towards the keeper
shortish on middle and off. Jaiswal hops around his crease before prodding it back to the bowler
very full outside off. Jaiswal jams down on it and pokes it out towards mid off
length ball on the pads. Jaiswal stays back and works it towards deep mid wicket
length ball on leg. Jurel goes back and tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
fizzed through on a length just outside off. Jaiswal pokes it towards deep square leg
full outside off. Jurel comes onto the front foot and knocks it to long on

miscued and Sooryavanshi is outta here! Rashid with the breakthrough! Back of a length on middle and leg, and this seems to just stick in the surface. Sooryavanshi has a slog at it but does not get it well enough. Picks out Phillips to perfection at deep mid wicket, and the Kiwi was not dropping that - not in a million years. GT with a vital, vital wicket!
length outside off. Jaiswal gets onto the front foot and drives with an open bat face towards deep point
back of a length on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi plays with the angle towards mid wicket
full toss on middle and off. Jaiswal happy to knock it to long on
what timing! Back of a length on middle and off. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and clips it gently between square leg and short fine. The ball keeps gathering pace and hits the fence!
right out of the screws! Marginally short outside off and that is all Jaiswal needs. He stands tall and whacks it over mid on!
shortish outside off. Jaiswal tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it towards extra cover
on a length outside off. Sooryavanshi comes onto the front foot and punches it on the up into the cover region
full outside off. Jaiswal comes forward and jabs it towards extra cover
another short ball, getting up near the ribs on off. Jaiswal opens up his stance and tugs it past mid wicket for a couple of runs

oh! Sharp short ball on middle and leg. Zips through and Jaiswal, trying to upper-cut it, is late on the stroke. Buttler thinks there is bat involved but no support from elsewhere. UltraEdge returns a flat line
back of a length on off. Sooryavanshi pushes it to mid off and this time, the single is a much more comfortable exercise
oh goodness me - that is some shot! Dug in short outside off. Sooryavanshi arches his back, uses the pace and glides it over the deep third fence!

nicked and grassed! Length ball slanted across the batter outside off. Sooryavanshi throws the plumbing at it and gets a healthy nick that Buttler, flying to his left, cannot quite hold on to. Another tough chance. The ball then deflects off his glove and into the deep third fence. Siraj, who was giving chase, has done some damage to himself too. GT will hope he is fine!
fetch that, says Jaiswal! Banged half-way down and this sits up nicely on middle and off. Jaiswal picks it up and dumps it over the deep mid wicket fence!
off-pace on a back of a length just outside off. Jaiswal waits for it before tapping it towards backward point
back of a length outside off and this skids through. Jaiswal wants to dab this behind point but is late on the stroke

direct hit and it would have been curtains for the teenager! Zipped in full on the stumps. Sooryavanshi tips it to mid off and sets off for the run. Rashid takes aim and lets the RR opener off the hook!
over the top again! Width offered this time and Sooryavanshi can throw his hands at it, with this also being on the shorter side. Flayed over point!
banged in short outside off and this sails over the batter's head. Easy decision for the umpire once the batter lets it go
low full toss outside off. Sooryavanshi has a jab at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards mid wicket
back of a length on middle and off. Jaiswal taps it to mid wicket and wants the single but gets sent back by his partner. Right call too

did that carry?! And was it off the glove? Shortish and sneaking down leg. Jaiswal tries to help it fine and seems to get a nick. Buttler dives low to his right but cannot make it stick. That carried, meaning it will go down as a chance, albeit a tough one!

a bit of a shank but it still carries well over mid off! Hard length outside off. Jaiswal opens up his stance and swings for the hills. Slices it a touch but still plenty on it. One bounce and into the fence!
hard length on leg, tucking up the batter for room. Jaiswal hops around his crease and stabs it back to the bowler
line goes awry again. On a back of a length and down leg. Jaiswal does not get bat on it and the umpire has to indulge in some more exercise
four more! Siraj loses his line again and pays the price. Back of a length on the pads and Jaiswal tickles it past short fine leg!
Jaiswal lands his first punch now! Length ball hung up wide outside off. Jaiswal frees his arms and carves it over cover!
back of a length on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi meets it right under his eyes and with relatively soft hands
up and over! Length just outside off and that is all Sooryavanshi needs. He sets up a solid base and muscles it over mid off!
very full just outside off. Sooryavanshi jams down on it and digs it out to mid on
full and speared down leg. Sooryavanshi misses his flick and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length outside off. Sooryavanshi gets up on his toes and defends
back of a length on middle and leg. Jaiswal lets the ball come to him before glancing it down to long leg
back of a length outside off. Sooryavanshi opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third
hard length just outside off. Not a lot of room to work with and Jaiswal jabs it towards cover
fuller outside off and this shapes in a touch too. Sooryavanshi comes forward and drives it to long on
more runs! Short and down leg again. Sooryavanshi lets the ball come to him before swiping it into the long leg fence!
back of a length on middle and leg. Nips in sharply and Sooryavanshi gets jammed on the pad. Late on the flick
off the mark with a boundary yet again! Full and drifting onto the pads. Sooryavanshi uses the swing and the pace and glances it into the long leg fence!
back of a length, shaping into the pads. Jaiswal tucks it through square leg and gets off the mark

and Deshpande has won a thriller for the Royals! Deshpande thumps his chest in pure victory elation and then does the gesture showing everyone around the country and the world that this is his stage. What a game, and what a finishing act by Deshpande! Full toss speared into the stumps. There to be hit but with the pressure on his shoulders, Ashok shanks it off the inside edge into his body. The ball rolls away harmlessly behind square and now, cue the wild celebrations. RR have pulled this one out of the fire, and Deshpande has been front and centre of GT's hopes being extinguished!

sliced out to the fence, and Archer snares the chance! Deshpande is having the night of his life under the Ahmedabad lights! On a length and hung up wide outside off. Rashid throws the plumbing at it but he slices it way too much. Off the outer half and Archer, prowling on the deep point fence, rattles to his right to gobble it up. Parag is pumped. Deshpande is pumped. GT on the ropes one final time perhaps!
oh my! Deshpande sticks to his guns, and Rashid cannot get his scoop away. Tries to shuffle across to this very full ball outside off and gets nutmegged for his troubles!
this is superb bowling. Another yorker outside off and Rabada can only clonk it back to the bowler, who gets his right hand to it but cannot quite prevent the single
excellent yorker on middle and off. Rashid opens his bat face and digs it out towards deep third. Just a single, and this is getting tougher for GT now!
low full toss outside off. Rabada sits deep in his crease and squeezes it out towards sweeper cover
Deshpande starts with a wayward delivery. A full toss a mile outside off and once Rabada swings like a rusty gate and misses, the umpire calls it a wide

high full toss outside off. Rabada backs away and throws the kitchen sink at it. Misses it completely and the keeper fumbles too, allowing a bye. But hang on, there could be more drama in this still. Rabada wants to review, arguing this is above the waist. Not sure he has a case here, though. Seems to be below the waist in real-time, and Ball Tracking confirms those suspicions. 21cm below the waist, and that will be just a bye!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Rabada jams it back to the bowler, who gets his hands to it to his right. Vital dot ball

big, big lbw shout, and Archer wants the review. And he gets the review too! Zipped in full on middle stump. Rashid sits deep in his crease and seems to get a scratch on it before getting pinged on the back leg. Rashid thinks there is an inside edge, and the umpire's call is vindicated. UltraEdge confirms bat is involved, and Rashid stays!
dug in short on leg. Rabada cramped for room on the pull again and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
sharp bumper, tucking up the batter on leg. Rabada has to work against the angle from around the wicket too and gets tagged on the body
length outside off. Rashid tries to smash it into next week and chunks it off the inside edge into his pads
another top yorker on middle and off. Rashid gives himself a bit of room and clinks it out into the off side
into the blockhole on the pads. Rashid tucks it off his toes towards deep backward square leg. Rashid takes on Jadeja's arm again and he makes it!
low full toss wide outside off. Rabada throws his hands at it and slices it towards deep point

Kagiso Rabada, you absolute champion! This is hitting of the highest order, and hitting when the pressure is on. Slower ball on a length outside off. Rabada works out the angle from around the wicket and smokes it into the sightscreen!
leg-cutter on a length on off. Rashid dabs it towards backward point
oh, this is beautiful batting! Very full outside off. Rashid steps down, opens his bat face and steers it between backward point and short third!
clean as a whistle! Flighted up into the slot on middle and off. Rabada channels his inner Brian Lara and launches it over the bowler's head!
leg-spinner fizzed through on a length on off. Rabada stays back and prods it into the off side
googly on a length just outside off. Rabada, caught on the crease, goes feeling for it and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
googly on a fullish length outside off. Rashid drops it into the off side and takes a single. Smart batting
four more - the runs are flowing now! A leg-spinner but dragged down outside off. Rashid rocks back and scythes it just behind point!
googly on a back of a length just outside off. Rabada goes back and knocks it to long on
back of a length on middle and off. Rashid hangs back and in a cramped motion, tugs it towards mid wicket
full toss on middle and off. Rabada stabs it towards mid off and picks up another single
pressure? What pressure, asks Rabada?! Back of a length on off. Rabada gives himself ample room and slams it mid off!
full toss on middle and leg. Rashid opens his bat face and squeezes it past backward point
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Rabada jams it out towards extra cover and picks up a single
full outside off. Rashid sits deep in his crease and drills it towards sweeper cover
another close shave! Bishnoi has the ball on a string today. Another ripping googly, pitching on a length on leg and ragging past the outside edge, and also past off stump!

oh dear lord - what are the Titans doing?! This is an implosion and then some! Hung up full and wide. Rashid cracks it past extra cover. The two is on but Shahrukh thinks the third might be as well. Not the wisest of calls ot take on Jadeja, though. Not this season. Not in any season. Shahrukh has to scramble to the batter's end and is still well short. Jadeja with a moment of customary fielding magic, and GT are reeling now!

through everyone and everything! Fizzing googly, pitching on a back of a length outside off. Zips in and Rashid is cut in half. Keeper cannot get to it either, and that was not far away from the stumps. Given as runs, interestingly!

Bishnoi has the final word, and he is ripping through this Titans batting unit! Googly on a back of a length outside off. Tewatia tries to carve it behind point but the over-spin on this delivery means the ball kisses the top edge before nestling into Jurel's gloves. Sharp take, it must be said, and this is another body blow to GT's hopes!
this is a thumping blow! Back of a length on middle and leg. Tewatia sits down on the reverse and nails it over short third!
nicked and four! Googly on a length on middle and off. Tewatia tries to play a bit of French cricket and the ball bobbles off the outside edge past short third!
nicely done! Banged in short on middle and leg. Shahrukh gives himself just enough room and ramps it wonderfully over the keeper!
slower ball on a length outside off. Shahrukh comes forward and prods it towards extra cover
pick the bones out of that one! Half-tracker outside off and this sits up just the way Shahrukh wants it to. He loads up and clatters it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Tewatia drops it into the extra cover region and hares across to the other end
back of a length on the stumps. Shahrukh turns it into the on side to open his account

top-edged to fine leg, and Buttler bites the dust too! The Titans are crumbling now! Banged in short outside off and this hurries onto Buttler. Gets big on him too, especially from around the wicket and Buttler cannot control his pull. Tame top edge to Sandeep, and he does the rest at fine leg. RR in control now!
back of a length on middle and leg. Buttler tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket
short and wide outside off. Tewatia has a waft at it and slices it towards deep backward point
googly on a length outside off. Tewatia comes forward and defends with an open bat face

four and out, and GT are throwing this away! This is full and on the pads. There to be hit, but perhaps along the ground. Sundar tries to get under it but the lack of room means he does not do so adequately. Plinked straight to deep mid wicket, and this GT chase is wobbling now!
well, that is one way to announce yourself! Floated up full just outside off. Sundar stretches forward and bangs it over the bowler's head!

goneski, and Bishnoi is weaving his magic in Ahmedabad! Googly on a back of a length on off. Phillips wants to muscle this downtown but the inward angle means he cannot fully free his arms. Chips it towards long on and Archer hurtles in off the line, lunging forward to send Phillips on his way. GT pegged back yet again!
third boundary in the over, 15 off the 12th, and Buttler is rattling along now! This is a half-tracker outside off. Buttler rocks back and hammers it to deep mid wicket's right!
Buttler in full flow now! Length outside off. Buttler transfers his weight forward, goes through the line and pops it over extra cover!
banged in shorter outside off. Phillips jumps up onto his toes and jabs it towards deep point
back of a length outside off. Buttler stays on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep point
this is Buttler at his best! Back of a length outside off. Buttler reads Deshpande's mind like a mentalist and moves across his stumps to lap it over the keeper!
back of a length outside off. Phillips jabs it enough to extra cover's left and picks up a single
shot! Too short, too wide and that is enough for Buttler. He uses the pace, focuses on timing and cracks it through point!
back of a length on off. Phillips hangs back and punches it to long on

shanked and taken! Big, big moment in the game! Not the best ball Bishnoi will ever bowl but he will take it. Of course he will. A bit of a drag-down on middle and leg. Sudharsan shapes up for the mighty swipe over deep mid wicket but skews it straight down Deshpande's throat at deep backward square leg instead. Just the opening RR were craving!
googly on a back of a length outside off. Prodded out towards extra cover
throws it up on a length wide outside off, perhaps after sensing the charge. Buttler manages to reach it but chops it off the under-edge past the keeper
googly on a back of a length and this finishes a touch outside off, Sudharsan short-arm-jabs it to deep mid wicket and the siren goes off because Bishnoi has cut the return crease...
googly on a back of a length on off. Buttler hangs back and tugs it on the bounce to long on
clever, clever batting! Bashed half-way down but Sudharsan knows it is coming. He stays leg side of the ball, arches his back to get the elevation and ramps it over the keeper!
banged in short outside off. Comes off slower than Buttler expects and he drags it towards deep backward square leg
back of a length outside off. Buttler opens his bat face and dabs it straight to backward point
this is a Buttler classic! Length ball in the channel. Buttler stays on top of the bounce and lets his hands do all the work. Creams it on the up between mid off and extra cover!
short and wide outside off. Sudharsan jumps out to reach it and slaps it towards mid off. Good stop by Parag to his right
shortish on the hips. Buttler a little late on the flick and the ball rolls off his thigh pad behind square
back of a length outside off. Sudharsan hangs back and dabs it towards backward point
this is a mighty hit! Fired into the slot outside off and no half-measures from Sudharsan. He drops down to one knee and mauls it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Sudharsan hops back and punches it to long on
short, wide and put away! Ample width on offer and Sudharsan, by getting his hands through the ball, crashes it into the deep point fence!
flighted up full on off. Buttler comes forward and knocks it to long off to open his account
back of a length outside off. Sudharsan bunts it into the vacant mid wicket region

and Parag's event-filled over ends with a wicket! Lobbed up on a length on off. Kushagra gets down on one knee and swings at it with all his might. Gets more height than distance and Hetmyer, stood right on the fence, seems to take it before doing the juggling act and completing the catch. Third umpire pressed into action to see if all is good, and that is indeed the case. GT's opening partnership broken!
back of a length on the stumps. Nudged off the back foot towards deep mid wicket
Sudharsan brings up his 13th IPL half-century in pristine fashion! This is a hit-me ball. Full toss outside off and Sudharsan mauls it over cow corner!
seems a little slower, on a full length on middle and leg. Sudharsan shapes for the sweep and seems to get a scratch on it before getting rapped on the pad
flighted up on a length just outside off. Sudharsan has a tentative prod at it and chunks it off the inside edge into the on side
welcomed with a sublime shot! Tossed up full just outside off. Sudharsan gives himself a bit of room and caresses it between extra cover and long off!
length outside off. Sudharsan turns it towards deep mid wicket and retains strike
back of a length on off. Punched uppishly towards long off
on the shorter side again, outside off. Sudharsan hops back and tugs it to deep mid wicket
dragged down outside off. Sudharsan hangs back and hacks it to long on's left. Back for another brace
pushed in on a length on the stumps. Sudharsan dinks it perfectly between deep mid wicket and deep square, and hurtles back for two
smart batting! Fired in on a back of a length outside off. Sudharsan opens his bat face late and uses Jadeja's pace to glide it fine past the keeper!
brilliant yorker on leg. Kushagra plays all around it and gets pinged on the boot. Might have been sliding down leg, though
pace-on and bashed in short on middle and off. Kushagra looks to upper-cut it but does not get any purchase on it
authoritative! Slower ball into the track outside off. Kushagra picks the knuckle-ball, dances down and bangs it over the bowler's head!
back of a length on off. Sudharsan lets the ball come to him before turning it towards deep square leg
low full toss on the pads and punished this time! Rolls his wrists nicely, uses the angle and clips it beautifully past mid wicket!
another misfield! Full toss outside off. Sudharsan flays it towards backward point, who fumbles and allows a couple of runs
low full toss on the pads. Sudharsan tucks it off his toes towards deep square leg and keeps strike
off-pace on a back of a length on middle and off. Sudharsan has a hack at it and does not make contact yet again
into the blockhole just outside off. Sudharsan cannot jam his bat down in time and that is three false strokes in as many balls
shortish on leg and this hurries onto Sudharsan too. He cannot get much purchase on his pull and the ball pops up off the thigh pad towards the keeper
back of a length outside off and this skids through. Sudharsan shapes up for the back-foot punch but is late on the stroke
bursts through the hands! Low full toss outside off. Sudharsan, with an open bat face, jams it into the turf and it is too hot to handle for Burger at short third!
angled in full on the stumps. Sudharsan drills it down the ground and nearly takes out his partner at the other end
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Sudharsan hangs back and stabs it to mid wicket
length outside off. Sudharan gets onto the front foot and jabs it towards cover point
fullish on middle and off. Driven down the ground to long on
four more! Another error in line. On a back of a length on the pads and Kushagra glances it neatly to short fine leg's left!
off-pace on a back of a length just outside off. Kushagra waits on it before tugging it past mid wicket for a couple of runs
shot! Short and laced with width, and Sudharsan does not miss out. He latches onto it and slashes it over backward point!
shortish outside off. Kushagra rides the bounce and runs it down to deep third
fullish outside off. Kushagra gets another good stride in before pushing it to mid off
first boundary for Kushagra! And it is an elegant stroke too. Full outside off. He leans forward and threads it between extra cover and mid off!
back of a length on off. Sudharsan bunts it to mid on and ambles across to the other end
length just outside off. Sudharsan comes forward and taps it gently towards mid on
back of a length on middle and off. Kushagra lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
length ball on middle and off. Kushagra presses half forward and blocks
length ball outside off. Sudharsan throws his hands at it and slices it down to deep third
length outside off. Sudharsan takes a step down the track and taps it towards point
edged and four! Back of a length in the channel and this nips away against the angle. Sudharsan is turned inside-out and the ball flies off the outside edge past slip!
another wild delivery. Short and way outside off. Jurel does well to get to this
back of a length just outside off. Kushagra drops it into the off side and saunters across to the other end
full, wide and put away! Sudharsan gets his hands through the ball nicely and cracks it between extra cover and cover point!
back of a length outside off and this whistles through. Sudharsan has a nibble at it and is beaten for pace
full outside off. Sudharsan presses forward and pushes it to mid off
back of a length just outside off. Moves away and Sudharsan gets squared up as he drops it into the off side
what a shot that is! Banged in short on middle and leg. Sudharsan arches his back, opens his bat face and guides it just over deep third!
full outside off. Sudharsan gets a half stride in and pokes it towards extra cover
oh dear - that is a huge wide! Even a leg slip might not have gotten to that. Full and a mile down leg. Shapes away further and ends up in a different postcode to the keeper!
